title: Connect an AI app to Sogverse
body: {clientName} is asking to act as you in Sogverse, with everything your admin account can do.
destinationLabel: Your sign-in will be sent to
loopbackHint: An app running on this computer.
unrecognised: School of Gaming doesn't recognise this destination. Only allow this if you have just started connecting from your own AI app. If you didn't, choose Deny.
failed: This request can no longer be answered. Start connecting again from your AI app.

unavailable.title: This sign-in link has already been used
unavailable.body: Each link works once and expires soon after. Start connecting again from your AI app.

refused.title: Only School of Gaming admins can connect an AI app
refused.body: You're signed in as {email}, which isn't an admin account.
